criteria.statement: A requirement row whose criteria names an id that no criterion row of the table has fails with unknown-criterion.

A requirement row with both proofs or neither fails, an agreed difference that does not name ADR-0083 fails, an agreed difference on an id that is not a sub-id fails with difference-on-parent, and a sub-id whose parent is not in the fixed list fails.

An id both in open and a row fails, and each id of the fixed in-scope list that is neither in open nor a row fails with missing-requirement. The list is B17.01 to B21.05 without B19.03, A01 to A18, B01 to B13, C01 to C08, D01 to D12, X01, X02, X04, X05, X06, G03, G04, G05, G06 and G10.
coverage/milestone-3.json passes unchanged, and a table with no requirements section is checked as before.
The table holds an agreed-difference row under its own sub-id for B17.01/utc, B17.06/head-unit, B18.07/model-call, B20.01/zones, X04/zone and G06/midnight, and none of them closes its parent.
A unit that declares fewer criteria than the plan gives it fails with below-plan, and a requirement row whose criteria differ from its planned ids fails with differs-from-plan.
A requirement row whose criteria all carry phoneSession or noAutomatedProof fails with no-named-test, unless the row has phoneSessionOnly with a reason.

A range holding a WORKOUT, a RACE_A, a RACE_B, a RACE_C, a NOTE and a HOLIDAY lists the four planning rows and only those, each with id, date, name, category, coachCreated, durationSeconds and load equal to the fixture.
With coachCreatedOnly true the same range lists only the coach-created rows, and a coach-tagged race is listed and still has coachCreated true.
A row with no moving_time has no durationSeconds key, a row with no icu_training_load has no load key, and a row with moving_time 0 lists durationSeconds 0.
An entry with no name lists with no name key, and the rest of the range lists normally.
A reversed range, a range of 367 days and a malformed date each answer with their refusal and make no read call, and a range of exactly 366 days is read.
An omitted newest reads up to the phone's day: with the phone clock at 00:30 on 1998-09-08 in Pacific/Auckland, newest is 1998-09-08.
The REST request still sends no category, and listEventsDoesNotFilterAwayMovedIdentities passes unchanged.
The list tool's description no longer says Filters to WORKOUT category only, and names workouts and races, races never changeable and coachCreatedOnly.
Every case of serializer-cases.json, regenerated by running npm's serializer at d192cb97, serializes to npm's description and movingTime byte for byte, or is refused where npm refuses it.
The 15-minute case with a repeat followed by a step in the same section has a blank line after the repeat block and a movingTime of 900.
A ride with 41 steps, 21 repeats, a 121-character name or label, 1501 W, 201 %FTP, or a ramp with one bound is refused as invalid_workout with no review and no calendar write.

Every case of serializer-cases.json, given as a ride add, builds a request body whose description and moving_time equal npm's description and movingTime byte for byte, and every case npm refuses is refused. A ride whose serialized duration is 0 seconds is refused as invalid_workout.
A Load of 41.6 is sent as icu_training_load 42 for a ride and a strength session, a Load of -1 is refused for both, and an add with no Load sends no icu_training_load.

A strength session of 37.5 minutes is sent with moving_time 2250, its trimmed effort and its description joined by one blank line, its trimmed name, and its own Load, and fractional minutes round to whole seconds as Math.round does.

A whitespace-only name, a 121-character name, a whitespace-only effort, a past date, a missing or empty field, a 4001-character description, and durations of 0, -5, infinity, 10^16 and 0.001 minutes are each refused before any write, and a whitespace-only description is accepted.
A ride and a strength session parsed from one input list keep their own type, name, date, duration, Load and description.
A body built with a CalendarWriteID carries category WORKOUT, that uid, external_id cycling-coach:<uid>, the coach tag, and no other field than the payload's.

An edit patch naming only the date, the name, durationSeconds, the description, trainingLoad or a native structure builds a request body with that one field: start_date_local at T00:00:00, the trimmed name, moving_time, description, icu_training_load rounded to a whole number, or workout_doc.

Authored steps in a patch's structure send the serializer's description and moving_time for every case of serializer-cases.json npm accepts, and no workout_doc. A native workout_doc is sent unchanged and becomes the desired structure. A description alone sends only the description and sets the desired structure to none, unless the description equals the current one after line endings are normalized.

A patch with no field, an unknown field, a past destination, a name of 121 characters or blank after trimming, an unreal date, a duration that is not a positive whole number of seconds, a 4001-character description, a negative Load, a structure that is not an object, or authored steps the serializer refuses is refused. Today's date, a 120-character name, an empty description, one second and a Load of 0 are accepted.
applied(to:) changes exactly the fields a patch names, alone or together, normalizes a patched description's line endings, and leaves every other field of the snapshot as it was.

CalendarEvent.snapshot of a list row read through the REST client holds its date, name, moving_time, icu_training_load, description with normalized line endings and workout_doc as normalized JSON, an absent or null value stays absent, and an event without a calendar date has no snapshot.
Each transition maps every stage to the documented next stage or refuses with wrongStage, every (stage, DriveStart) pair gives the documented NextStep, and no settle leaves the stage running.
Every change is in exactly one of finished, remaining and the stage's send attempt after every transition, and a finished change never returns to remaining.
answered with a lost answer gives readFirst, and settled with seen while work remains gives waiting(tryAgain(.settled)), so the run stops even when the change is found.
A refused answer puts the change back at the head of remaining with tryAgain(.refused(id, status)) for 400, 401, 403, 404 and 429.
differences(from:) names each changed field alone and ignores a change in server metadata or an equivalent representation, trailing whitespace and a moving_time equal after rounding.
isApplied(on:) is true exactly when applying the patch to the current snapshot changes nothing, an upgraded edit included.
The stored value round-trips, and a value with a change in two places or two changes at one position fails to decode.
sending(at:seen:) finishes each seen add as seen on the calendar, never with a Receipt, starts the send attempt of the first change not seen, and gives completed when every remaining change is seen.
nextStep(_:summarySaved:) gives publish for a completed or canceled review whose summary is not saved, and idle once it is.

OperationID.workoutReview encodes to the same workoutChangeSet:<ulid>:<rev> string as before, an old string decodes, and the build-2bbe2ee seed keeps its memory, review history and consent after the rename.

The minted-in-one-file rule fails each of its five patterns in a package file outside the owner, passes them in the owner, and passes ReviewReceipt( and other names that only contain Receipt or SendAttempt.

requirements.statement: The calendar list's omitted end date is the phone's day, not UTC today.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 makes the phone's time zone decide today for every read, so the list's omitted end date is the phone's day.

requirements.statement: Delivery of an approved ride to a Garmin or Wahoo head unit is not verified.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 leaves the head-unit half of B17.06 unverified, because the test account has no Garmin or Wahoo link.

requirements.statement: No model call judges an unfinished calendar request, and the reply's text is not held back.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 drops npm's extra model call for an unfinished request, and replies keep streaming while the card appears after the reply ends.

requirements.statement: Eligibility uses the phone's day when the phone's and the athlete's time zones differ.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 makes the phone's time zone decide today for every calendar change, so B20.01's different-zones check is an agreed difference.

requirements.statement: The athlete's civil date is the phone's day, not a date kept apart from the phone clock.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 makes the phone's time zone decide today for every read and change, with no note when the athlete's zone differs.

requirements.statement: An approval across the athlete's midnight is judged at the phone's midnight.
requirements.agreedDifference: ADR-0083 makes the phone's time zone decide today, so G06's athlete-midnight journey is an agreed difference.

requirements.statement: A strength session carries its date, trimmed name, rounded duration, trimmed effort, description and optional Load, refuses blank, out-of-range or unsafe values before any write, and keeps its own fields beside a ride in one list.
